animals.name: Star Chicken
animals.notes: Lays softly glowing eggs. Sell or cook.

animals.name: Constellation Sheep
animals.notes: Wool patterned like the night sky.

animals.name: Nebula Cow
animals.notes: Milk shimmers faintly pink. Prized by festival chefs.

animals.name: Comet Duck
animals.notes: Happiest paddling the restored Moonlit Pond. Eggs have streaky shells.

animals.name: Crater Goat
animals.notes: Climbs anything. Clears weeds from rocky plots it grazes.

animals.name: Asteroid Pig
animals.notes: Snuffles up buried crystal truffles from fallow plots.

animals.name: Moon Rabbit
animals.notes: Nibbles weeds at night. Crops it sleeps beside grow slightly faster.

animals.name: Biolume Fox
animals.notes: Quest reward pet. Deters pests on the plots it patrols.

animals.name: Glow Axolotl
animals.notes: Lives in the restored Moonlit Pond. Boosts fishing luck.

animals.name: Star Owl
animals.notes: Perches on the scarecrow. Night crops near it never attract pests.

animals.name: Cosmic Tortoise
animals.notes: Its shell is a tiny garden — moss and two mushrooms. Very slow. Very wise.

animals.name: Star Slime
animals.notes: Occasionally drops stardust used for tool upgrades.

animals.name: Comet Bees
animals.notes: Pollinators: +15% yield to crops within range and spread wildflowers.

animals.name: Prism Butterflies
animals.notes: Pollinators: flowers within range restore +1 extra rewilding point.

animals.name: Ember Fireflies
animals.notes: Light night plots so nocturnal crops can be tended without lanterns.
